meta.title: Wemuste — side jobs near you, on the map
meta.description: Find side jobs and full-time work near you. Verified sponsors only, and your profile is never public.

landing.headline: Side jobs near you, on the map.
landing.subhead: Browse real jobs from verified sponsors around the UAE. Tap one, send a request, get hired.
landing.step2: Tap a job on the map
landing.trustLine: Your profile is never public. Sponsors are checked by our team.
landing.mapAlt: Map of Dubai with job pins

authShell.trust2: Every sponsor is checked by our team
authShell.trust3: You choose which jobs to request

admin.homeBody: Manage sponsors and keep the map safe.
admin.createBody: Choose a password for the sponsor. We email them their login details and a link to log in.

admin.results: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# job seeker} other {# job seekers}}
admin.removeConfirm: Remove this job? It leaves the map and the sponsor can no longer edit it. You can restore it later.
admin.grantsBody: Share chosen job seekers with a sponsor, on top of the people who request their jobs.
admin.revokeConfirm: Revoke this access? The sponsor will lose access immediately.
admin.granted: {count, plural, one {Access granted to # job seeker} other {Access granted to # job seekers}}
admin.contentBody: The survey, test and video questions every job seeker answers. Only one survey and one test are live at a time.
admin.madeLive: Now live for new job seekers.
admin.questionsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No questions} one {# question} other {# questions}}
admin.title: Title
admin.samplesNote: [SAMPLE] items are placeholders. The client provides the real questions.
admin.promptsBody: Applicants answer the questions of the live set in short videos. New jobs use the live set.
admin.auditBody: Every admin action and every sponsor view of a job seeker. Entries can't be edited or deleted.
admin.jobsBody: Every job posted by sponsors. New jobs wait here until you approve them; then they appear on the map at once. All changes are logged.
admin.applicationsBody: Everyone who applied to a job. Review the test, videos and answers, then approve or reject. Sponsors only ever see approved applications for their own jobs.
admin.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No applications} one {# application} other {# applications}}
admin.reviewNotesPlaceholder: Why approve or reject? Visible to admins only.
admin.reviewNotesHint: Notes are for the Wemuste team only, never shown to sponsors or applicants.
admin.approveConfirm: Approve this application? The sponsor will be able to see it.
admin.approvedToast: Approved. The sponsor can now see this candidate.
admin.approveNote: Approving shares this application (survey, score and videos) with the sponsor who posted the job.
admin.viewLogged: Opening a video is recorded in the audit log.
admin.noSurvey: This application had no survey questions.
admin.writtenHint: Written answers are graded by an admin when reviewing each application.
admin.createdNoEmail: The account is ready, but the email to {email} couldn't be sent. Share the login details with them another way.
admin.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. It's sent to the sponsor by email, and they keep it until they change it.
admin.emailNewPassword: Email the new password to the sponsor
admin.passwordChangedEmailed: Password changed and emailed to the sponsor.
admin.deleteSponsorBody: This deletes the sponsor's login, logo, all their jobs and every application to those jobs, including videos. It can't be undone. To only stop them for now, use Suspend instead.
admin.rejectReason: Why can't it be approved? The sponsor sees this.
admin.rejectReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Please add the working hours and remove the phone number from the description.
admin.jobApprovedToast: Approved. The job is now on the map.

apply.title: Apply
apply.leaveConfirm: Leave now? Your progress is saved on this device for 24 hours.
